description: This header defines the absl::optional template class, including its constructors, assignment operators, modifiers, observers, relational operators, and comparison with nullopt and other types. It provides a C++11 compatible implementation of an optional value holder, similar to std::optional, with support for various utility functions and internal mechanisms.

classes.name: absl::optional
classes.description: A template class that holds either a value of type T or an empty state, providing value semantics and utility functions.

methods.name: optional()
methods.description: Default constructor creating an empty optional.

methods.name: operator=(nullopt_t)
methods.description: Assigns nullopt, making the optional empty.

methods.name: operator=(optional&&)
methods.description: Assigns from another optional via move.

methods.name: reset()
methods.description: Destroys the contained value, making the optional empty.

methods.name: emplace(Args&&...)
methods.description: Constructs the contained value in-place with arguments.

methods.name: emplace(std::initializer_list<U>, Args&&...)
methods.description: Constructs the contained value in-place with initializer list.

methods.name: swap(optional&)
methods.description: Swaps the contents with another optional.

methods.name: operator bool()
methods.description: Checks if the optional contains a value.

methods.name: has_value()
methods.description: Returns true if the optional contains a value.

methods.name: value()
methods.description: Returns a reference to the contained value, throws if empty.

methods.name: value_or(U&&)
methods.description: Returns the contained value or a default.
